office.en: Governor of California, November 3, 2026 general election. Democratic. Certified candidate list, August 27, 2026.

sourceTitle.en: Xavier Becerra for Governor 2026, Priorities page, last updated September 17, 2026

spectrumNote.en: Democrat, left of center on health care

summary.en: The priorities page says he would build toward a universal single-payer system. The longer health-care page still talks about premiums and out-of-pocket costs, so that line is not scored as care with no premiums or deductibles. The energy page calls a clean-energy transition necessary and does not set a date to leave coal, oil, and gas. The health-care page says he would protect access to abortion.

whyIncluded.en: One of the two candidates for governor on the certified November 2026 ballot. His campaign site is the source for the health, energy, and abortion lines below.
